FOOD
Refresh Your Stamina

At Groovy Goat, we care deeply about the quality of our food. Our scratch kitchen prepares every meal to order with the freshest ingredients available. From our wood-grilled wings, to our burgers and our specialty Tableside Nachos Your Way, we guarantee everyone will find their new favorite meal here at Groovy Goat.

OUR MENU

DRINK
Let Our Potions Take You To The Next Level

Groovy Goat isn't just for the kids. With over 25 draft beers, over 15 craft beers, and numerous other adult beverages on our menu, we guarantee our guests over 21 will find the perfect drink to wet their whistle while watching the game. We feature Happy Hour specials for each day of the week.

OUR DRINKS
MENU

ORDER ONLINE
Take Us Home With You!

Your favorite food is just a click away. Order online and enjoy!

ORDER
GAMES
Level Up Your Parties

From the biggest games in sports to over 50 games in our arcade, there's no better place to play and have fun than Groovy Goat. Our spacious party rooms, top-notch food & beverage menu, and proximity to both the Arcade and the Park at OWA make Groovy Goat the best place for parties and other events.

PARTIES

SPORTS
Catch The Game While Enjoying All Your Favorites!

Don't miss out on all the latest events coming to Groovy Goat and to OWA. We are THE home for UFC fights, championship games, live music, and all the great sporting events. Check our online Calendar to find out what's happening at Groovy Goat.

Great atmosphere, great service, great food. What more could you want? Hurricane Shrimp is divine! The dish arrived so pretty - almost couldn't eat because it was so pretty! Ate every bite! Delicious! Hubby ordered BBQ sliders w/fries. He ate every bite also, so it must have been really good (he's picky). Love the collwge sports themed walls. Also have a connecting arcade. Eat here, highly recommend.

OUR MENU
MENU

STARTERS & SHAREABLES
Wood - Grilled Oysters*
MKT
1/2 Dozen or Dozen | Featuring a garlic, parmesan, and scallion crust | When available.
Oysters on the Half Shell*
MKT
1/2 Dozen or Dozen | Served with atomic cocktail sauce and horseradish | When available.
Totchos
$13.00
Crispy tater tots smothered with sports bar chili, queso, pico, shredded lettuce, and jalapenos.
Crispy Parmesan Garlic Mushrooms
$10.50
Served with a rich herb aioli dipping sauce.
Louisiana BBQ Shrimp
$18.00
Whole Gulf shrimp sauteed with Cajun spices, garlic, beer, butter sauce, and Worcestershire, served with crispy crostini.
Blue Crab Dip
$18.00
Creamy blue crab dip served piping hot with tortilla chips
Fried Green Beans
$12.00
Green beans coated in a spicy batter fried crispy served with wasabi ranch
Pretzels & Queso
$10.00
Three warm and thick pretzel sticks served with house-made queso and creole mustard.
Pickle Fry Up
$13.50
Crispy pickles, poblanos, and jalapenos, served with creole mustard and ranch dipping sauce.
Battered Mozzarella Sticks
$10.00
Three lightly battered cheese sticks, served with a side of marinara sauce.
SOUPS & SALADS

Add to any salad: Grilled or Crispy Chicken Breast +$6.00 | Steak or Shrimp +$7.00

Bowl of Chili
$8.50
Topped with melted cheddar and Monterey Jack, fresh jalapenos, scallions, and sour cream.
Bowl of Clam & Bacon Chowder
$9.00
Tender sea clams with onions, potatoes, celery, bacon, cream, and herbs.
Caesar Salad
$10.00
Hand-cut romaine lettuce tossed with Caesar dressing, herb croutons, and parmesan.
Bacon & Bleu Wedge Salad
$11.00
A wedge of iceberg lettuce with grape tomatoes, crispy bacon strips, red onions, and bleu cheese crumbles topped with bleu cheese dressing.
Cobb Salad
$16.00
A generous portion of bacon, egg, avocado, shredded cheese, bleu cheese crumbles, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion over a house lettuce blend; choice of dressing
The Greek
$11.00
Chopped romaine lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, red onions, olives, pepperoncini, marinated feta cheese, served with house Greek dressing.
MELTS

Served with a side of fries | Premium Sides +$2.00

Loaded Philly
$15.00
Steak and melted American cheese griddled with peppers, onions, mushrooms, and herb aioli on a hoagie roll | Double Meat & Cheese +$7.00
Italian Beef
$15.50
Steak, griddled onions, spicy vegetable relish, Swiss cheese on hoagie roll, and "Italian Jus" for dipping | Double Meat & Cheese +$7.00
Owa Grown - Up Grilled Cheese
$14.50
A generous blend of sliced cheddar, Swiss, shredded cheddar jack, and bleu cheese crumbles with red onion bacon jam and avocado on a buttery, griddled rye bread.
Southern Reuben
$16.00
Sliced corned beef, Swiss cheese, cole slaw, pickles, and jalapeno remoulade on griddled rye bread.
TABLESIDE NACHOS

Your way!

Tableside Nachos
$25.00
Experience nachos in a way that is simply out of this world. Our nacho servers come to your table and completely customize your oversized nacho platter exactly the way you and your party want it. All nachos start with a pile of chips, sports bar chili, and queso. From there you can customize your table with any combination of extra cheese, shredded lettuce, sour cream, pico, and fresh jalapenos • Add Chicken or Guacamole to half +$4.00 | Add Steak or Shrimp +$7.00 | Really Hungry? Add Them All +$20.00 (Each additional portion is enough for half of the oversized platter).
G.O.A.T. WINGS

Greatest of all time | One bite of our wood-grilled or crispy wings and you will see why they are the greatest!

G.O.A.T. Wings
Bone-in: 5 Wings $9.00 | 10 Wings $16.00| 20 Wings $30.00 • Boneless: 8 Wings $9.00 | 16 Wings $16.00 | 24 Wings $30.00 • Available as traditional bone-in or new hand-cut, bite-size, hand-breaded, boneless chicken breast | Available flavors: Buffalo, Cola Teriyaki, Sticky Honey & Black Pepper, Sweet BBQ, House Medium VooDoo, Thai Chili, Parmesan Garlic, Lemon Pepper (Dry Rub), Korean BBQ, Hot Habanero, Honey Habanero (Dry Rub), Carribean Jerk (Dry Rub), Old Bay (Dry Rub)
HANDHELDS

Served with a side of fries | Premium Sides +$2.00 | Substitute a Gluten-free Wrap +$1.00

Comfort Buttermilk Chicken
$16.50
Buttermilk-brined chicken breast with a crispy coating on a buttery toasted brioche roll with house-made day pickles, shredded lettuce, and jalapeno remoulade.
Turkey Avocado Wrap
$15.50
Sliced turkey breast, avocado, shredded lettuce, bacon, fresh tomato, and cheddar on a flour tortilla with rich herb aioli.
Fish Sandwich
$18.00
Redfish served wood-grilled or crispy breaded on a brioche bun with vinegar slaw and jalapeno remoulade.
Breakfast BLT*
$11.00
Smoked center-cut bacon, sunny-side up egg, arugula, tomato, and bacon jam on toasted brioche, served with crispy tater tots | Add Bacon +$2.50
BURGERS

All of our burgers are a 1/2 pound wood-grilled Angus blend of chuck, short rib, and brisket. Served on a buttery toasted brioche roll with your choice of one side • Premium Sides +$2.00 | Substitute a Plant-Based Patty +$2.00 • Add Fried Egg +$1.50 | Add Bacon +$2.50

The Classic*
$15.00
Aged cheddar, shredded lettuce, tomatoes, onion, and house-made day pickles.
Mushroom Burger*
$16.00
Fresh sauteed garlic mushrooms, Swiss cheese, arugula, and rich herb aioli.
Bleu Burger*
$16.00
Bleu cheese bacon sauce, onion, and arugula.
Bar Burger*
$17.00
Sunny-side-up egg, bacon, cheddar, shredded lettuce, tomatoes, onion, and house-made day pickles.
Burger of the Month
MKT
Ask your server about this month's burger special.
MAIN SQUEEZES

Served with your choice of two sides, unless otherwise specified, or upgrade to a premium side +$2.00

Chopped Steak & Mushrooms*
$21.00
One pound signature USDA choice chopped hamburger steak with mashed potatoes, parmesan garlic mushrooms, and red wine gravy (no additional sides or substitutions) | Add Five Shrimp +$8.00
Steak & Frites*
$28.00
Wood-grilled sirloin steak with parmesan garlic fries (counts as one side) | Add Five Shrimp +$8.00
Chicken Fingers Platter
$17.50
Buttermilk tenders in crispy coating and your choice of wing sauce.
Crispy Shrimp Platter
$18.50
Gulf shrimp hand-breaded with seasoned flour served with atomic cocktail sauce and jalapeno remoulade.
Crab Cake Platter
$26.00
Two Maryland-style crab cakes loaded with lump blue crab.
Goat Whistle Fish & Chips
$16.50
A generous portion of Goat Whistle beer-battered cod served with fries, vinegar slaw, and a side of jalapeno remoulade (no additional sides or substitutions).
Grilled Chicken Platter
$16.50
Two fresh grilled chicken breasts simply seasoned served with two sides
Fully Smothered Style Grilled Chicken Platter
$21.50
Two fresh grilled chicken breasts loaded with bacon, BBQ sauce & melted cheddar

Accessibility Statement for Groovy Goat - Owa

Groovy Goat - Owa is committed to making our site accessible to people with disabilities. We are continuously gathering feedback and improving the user experience for everyone.

Conformance

To provide great experience to everyone we are using The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG). The guidelines have three levels of accessibility (A, Level AA, and Level AAA). Groovy Goat - Owa has chosen level AA as a target for our website and we are fully committed to monitoring our site to maintain this level of compliance.

Third-Party Vendors

We encourage our third party vendors (online order and delivery providers, reservations and event management, social media, review sites, travel recommendation sites, etc.) to provide content that is accessible and user friendly, even though we cannot control their content that appears on our website.

Feedback

How are we doing? We welcome your feedback on how to improve accessibility and usability of Groovy Goat - Owa website. Please let us know using this email address: E-mail: foley@groovygoat.us

We try to respond to feedback within 2 business days.

Assistance

If you need any assistance please call us at 2519994628 during our regular business hours and we'd be happy to help you with anything on our site.
